mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Strike Super with up to six consecutive attacks. Each correctly timed additional input strengthens the corresponding strike, and the user glows red to signal successful timing; landing the correct timing on all inputs triggers a special camera angle for the final blow. The dedicated reference reports each individual hit at 5%; exact timing windows and patch-independent scaling remain unresolved.
